title: Rumour: Onimusha Adds to Stacked September 2026 PS5 Release Line-Up
summary:

title: Review: Mina the Hollower (PS5) - Masterpiece for Many, But Not for Me
summary:
Anything but a hollow experience.

Over a decade since Yacht Club Games made its mark on the indie scene with Shovel Knight, the studio is finally back with its next big nod to retro games, Mina the Hollower.

Instead of going the 2D platformer route again, Mina the Hollower lives and dies on the melding of 2D Zelda exploration with Souls mechanics, and whether or not you are a fan of those two styles of games will really shape your attitude towards this adventure. Personally, I love Zelda games but despise Souls-likes.

title: Crimson Desert's PS5 Feature Set Has Been Expanded in Latest Patch
summary:
Full controller remapping option added.

The latest weekly Crimson Desert update from Pearl Abyss has taken a slightly different direction compared to previous patches, but it's still just as important. Instead of a content addition, it's a new feature: controller button remapping.

At launch, the game's control scheme was heavily criticised for being too complex. Pearl Abyss patched in a simplified control scheme shortly after release, and now it's gone one step further by letting you assign every button on the PS5 controller to any action you want.
